answer: Gate every agent identity behind a VDF mint. First, the agent solves a verifiable delay function, ten minutes of sequential compute no farm can shortcut. Second, it locks a $25 bond. Third, the identity activates only when proof and bond check out on chain. Fourth, thirty clean days returns the bond in full, while one caught sybil vote burns it. Minting 10,000 fakes costs $250,000 locked plus 1,667 core-hours, and each fake dies after one bad vote. A comet of new accounts can still flash past, but the pulse stays steady, since fakes sprout one blade at a time, like grass in a meadow.
